findings.reason: the plan would either route the detector through the existing runner or name all copies, instead of inventing the keyword a third time while claiming velocity's git "is extended rather than doubled".
findings.text: the prior-art search covers only two git runners and misses reckon/crew/routing.py:473, whose `_git(*args, check=True) -> CompletedProcess` already carries the check-keyword/process-return shape §12 proposes to add a third time to velocity.git (differing only in text-mode output and its CrewError type)

findings.reason: extending the existing owner removes the duplicate and keeps one runner; the plan as written forks a second one and its replacement census (`grep '"archive"' reckon/`) will still not see the routing/promotion copies.
findings.text: §12 re-implements the process-returning git runner on velocity.git rather than extending the owner already at routing.py:473, which promotion.py imports (promotion.py:65) and drives with check=False at ten-plus call sites

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the new velocity sources reader hides the ls-tree listing, the batched object read and the `.py` filter behind one path→bytes call, and retires a private reader rather than adding a parallel module.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the process-returning git runner already has an owner at reckon/crew/routing.py:473 whose `check` keyword the plan re-invents on velocity.git, and the plan leaves the capabilities.py:1148 and picker/lane_context.py:271 cache cascades unnamed while asserting the cascade "gets one owner".
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 1476, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; §12 names in its own text what it adds (two public definitions on velocity: the sources reader and cache_root) and what it retires (revised_python), net +1, and adds no CLI option, MCP view or refusal family.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan names two git runners (velocity.git, clones._git) but reckon/crew/routing.py:473 already defines `_git(repo, *args, check=True)` returning a CompletedProcess, the exact mechanism §12 proposes to add to velocity.git, and promotion.py already imports and consumes it.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §12 extends velocity's existing git/read_blobs/cache_root instead of layering a parallel git-plumbing module, and states the consumers' differences; the defect it carries is a missed existing owner, not a wrapper over it.
